passage:
The city tested smart trash cans that sent a message when they were full. Workers could collect trash more efficiently instead of checking every can.
At first, the system saved time. Streets looked cleaner. But one neighborhood complained that their cans were still often full. The sensors worked, but there were too few cans in busy areas.
The city added more cans near markets and bus stops.
The project showed that smart technology can reveal problems, but it cannot solve all of them alone. A sensor can report that something is full. People still need to ask why it keeps becoming full and what should change.
